The '''Model 2 Wrist Mount''' was a device produced by [[Corellian Arms/Legends|Corellian Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It allowed a weapon to be worn on the user's wrist, thus allowing the use of his hands without interference.<ref name="DC" />
